annotations.title: Upload a creative to Google Ads

description: Add a creative to a Google Ads account’s ASSET LIBRARY so it can be used in ads. It does NOT have to be a Hermoso render — the user’s own creative is the normal case; the URL just has to be Hermoso-HOSTED because we fetch the bytes, so run any file of theirs through upload_file and pass the URL it returns. For an IMAGE, pass imageUrl (≤5MB); an arbitrary external/CDN URL is refused. For VIDEO, Google Ads uses YouTube-hosted videos — post the video to YouTube as UNLISTED first, then pass its youtubeVideoId here. For a PLAYABLE (App campaigns), pass playableUrl: an HTML5 zip with <!DOCTYPE html>, an ad.orientation meta tag and no outside files except Google's own (exitapi.js, Google Fonts); add appAdId to put it on an App ad. Returns the asset resource name. Pass customerId (from list_google_ads_campaigns).

appAdId.description: also add the playable to this App ad (App campaigns for installs only)

assetResourceName.description: with appAdId: add a playable already in the asset library instead of uploading one

customerId.description: 10-digit account id (dashes ok) — omit to use the brand’s selected default account

imageUrl.description: a Hermoso-hosted image URL for an IMAGE asset (≤5MB) — a Hermoso render, or the user’s OWN creative put through upload_file first. An arbitrary external/CDN URL is refused.

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

playableUrl.description: PLAYABLE: link to an HTML5 zip (any public https URL or upload_file). Checked against Google's rules, then Google's own free validation, then created as a MEDIA_BUNDLE asset

youtubeVideoId.description: A YouTube video id for a VIDEO asset
